title: DIVIDE of a currency by an integer is a currency, as with /

source.quote: The division (/) operator displays the same behavior as the DIVIDE function
source.supports: DIVIDE has the result types of /

source.quote: The result is always decimal, unless a currency is divided by an integer or by a decimal; in this case, the result is currency.
source.supports: the result type of / and of DIVIDE
Microsoft says DIVIDE returns a decimal number: the other reading

derivation: By SQLBI, DIVIDE has the result types of /, and a currency divided by an integer is a currency: 10 / 4 = 2.5.
alternative: DIVIDE always returns a decimal number, as the Microsoft page says: 2.5 (double).
